title: Missing Link admission contract — executable dogfood audit
summary: TOE-TEST-0060 executes the upstream Missing Link characterization test, hashes its paper copy and code/config inputs, and freezes the observed contract. The run reproduces 12 generated candidates, 0 accepted candidates, and a biomedical profile whose shared overlap metric yields an empty feasible region. Its verdict is ABSTAIN because the source worktree is dirty and the probe cannot establish a general claim about abduction or scientific discovery.
findings: CHAR-011 reproduced 12 generated candidates and 0 accepted candidates under the recorded shipped configuration.
CHAR-012 reproduced an empty biomedical feasible region: max_single >= 0.92 and max_single <= 0.90.
The recorded test passing means the defect before-image was reproduced; it is not a product PASS or a model-capability result.
A future repair needs an after-image that attributes grounding, omega, and novelty changes separately.
